fragrances.name: Santal 33
fragrances.description: Dry, creamy sandalwood wrapped in soft leather, cardamom and a violet-iris powder. Cool, dry and easy to recognize, it has become a kind of uniform for creative city dwellers.
cons: Some noses pick up a pickle-like note

fragrances.name: Another 13
fragrances.description: A near-abstract haze of ambroxan and musk with a faint pear and moss shading. Up close it smells like warm, clean skin, but it carries further than you would expect.
cons: Some people cannot smell its key molecules
Very pricey for a minimalist scent

fragrances.name: Gypsy Water
fragrances.description: Crisp lemon, bergamot and juniper drift over pine needles and a wisp of incense, then soften into powdery vanilla and sandalwood. Free-spirited and airy, it smells like a sunlit walk through the woods.
cons: Projection softens after the first hour

fragrances.name: Mojave Ghost
fragrances.description: A soft, powdery woody floral: magnolia and a hint of exotic fruit over cedar and musk. It drifts close to the body, like warm skin in dry desert air.

fragrances.name: Baccarat Rouge 540
fragrances.description: A glowing, airy amber of saffron, jasmine and ambergris over resinous woods, with a burnt-sugar sheen. Its bright, almost mineral trail gets noticed from across a room.
cons: Harsh or metallic to some noses

fragrances.name: Grand Soir
fragrances.description: A rich, resinous amber of labdanum and benzoin, smoothed with tonka and vanilla. Golden and enveloping, it suits cognac and candlelight on a winter night.

fragrances.name: Aventus
fragrances.description: A smoky, fruity chypre where bright pineapple and blackcurrant meet birch smoke and musky oakmoss. Confident and polished, it is built to leave an impression.
cons: Batch variation in smokiness and strength

fragrances.name: Silver Mountain Water
fragrances.description: Cool bergamot and mandarin brighten a green-tea heart with a tart blackcurrant edge, resting on clean musk and soft sandalwood. Its crisp, almost icy clarity makes it a refined choice for warm days.
pros: Great in heat and at the office

fragrances.name: Layton
fragrances.description: Sweet, spiced apple and lavender melt into cardamom, vanilla and woods. It is an inviting crowd-pleaser that feels warm and self-assured on cool nights.

fragrances.name: Delina
fragrances.description: A luminous pink rose sweetened with lychee and tart rhubarb over soft musk and cashmeran. It is feminine and polished, a match for its pink bottle.
cons: Can be too sweet for some

fragrances.name: Philosykos Eau de Toilette
fragrances.description: A photorealistic fig portrait: bruised green leaves, milky sap and creamy fruit resting on dry, sun-warmed wood. It evokes a lazy afternoon in the shade of a Mediterranean fig tree.
cons: Green-milky style is not for everyone

fragrances.name: Do Son Eau de Toilette
fragrances.description: A gentle, breezy tuberose softened by sea air and orange blossom, inspired by a seaside childhood in Vietnam. It gives you tuberose without the heaviness.
cons: May be too light for tuberose lovers

fragrances.name: Replica By the Fireplace
fragrances.description: Toasted chestnut and smoky guaiac wood warmed by clove and pink pepper, then sweetened with vanilla and Peru balsam. It captures the drowsy comfort of a log fire in a snowed-in cabin.
cons: Smoke can be too much for some

fragrances.name: Replica Lazy Sunday Morning
fragrances.description: A soft cloud of white musk brightened by aldehydes, pear and a touch of lily of the valley, with powdery iris underneath. It reads calm, clean and close to the skin, like a slow start to a day off.

fragrances.name: Love, Don't Be Shy
fragrances.description: Orange blossom and neroli drenched in fluffy marshmallow, sugar and vanilla, with a faint animalic warmth underneath. An unapologetically indulgent floral gourmand.

fragrances.name: Angels' Share
fragrances.description: A cinnamon-dusted cognac gourmand with praline, tonka and toasted oak. Like a warm spiced liqueur by the fire, it is rich and made for winter nights.

fragrances.name: Naxos
fragrances.description: Honey-glazed tobacco leaf wrapped in lavender and Sicilian citrus, finishing in tonka and vanilla. It is a rich, golden homage to Sicily with a gentlemanly polish.

fragrances.name: Hacivat
fragrances.description: A sharp, zesty pineapple and grapefruit chypre over oakmoss and dry woods. It is often compared to Aventus, but brighter, greener and more intense.
pros: Beast-mode performance for a fresh scent

fragrances.name: Ani
fragrances.description: A spicy-fresh vanilla: ginger and pepper cut into a creamy, resinous vanilla-benzoin base. It is a gourmand that feels grown-up rather than sugary.

fragrances.name: Not a Perfume
fragrances.description: A single-molecule scent built on ambroxan: clean, faintly salty woody-amber warmth that melts into skin. Some wearers can barely smell it on themselves, while people around them notice it.

fragrances.name: Molecule 01
fragrances.description: Nothing but Iso E Super: a soft, cedar-tinged woody warmth that flickers in and out of perception. It behaves less like a perfume and more like a faint personal aura.
cons: Nose fatigue makes it seem to vanish

fragrances.name: Portrait of a Lady
fragrances.description: A grand, dark Turkish rose laced with spice and raspberry over deep patchouli and incense. It is opulent, regal and commanding.

fragrances.name: Interlude Man
fragrances.description: A billowing cloud of smoky frankincense, oregano and amber over leather and oud. Dense and dramatic, it is made for cold nights and confident wearers.

fragrances.name: African Leather
fragrances.description: A warm, spicy leather: saffron, cardamom and cumin over earthy vetiver and suede-like leather. It evokes dusty heat and golden savanna grass.
cons: Cumin can read sweaty to some

fragrances.name: Halfeti
fragrances.description: A plush rose woven with saffron, cardamom and smooth oud on a leathery amber base. It takes its name and inspiration from a Turkish village known for its dark roses.
cons: Oud may be too much for some

fragrances.name: Orange Sanguine
fragrances.description: Juicy blood orange with a bitter-peel edge, lifted by black pepper and geranium and resting on soft amber and sandalwood. It carries the easy, sunny mood of a Mediterranean summer.

fragrances.name: Wood Sage & Sea Salt
fragrances.description: Mineral sea-salt spray and soft ambrette musk meet dry, herbal sage with a hint of grapefruit. Relaxed and airy, it recalls a cool afternoon stroll along the shoreline.

fragrances.name: Fleur Narcotique
fragrances.description: A bright, juicy white floral: jasmine and peony lifted by lychee and peach over soft musk. It is cheerful yet polished enough for a wedding or the office.
